title: Crypto accounting platform Cryptio warns customers that exchange and custodian credentials could be compromised
date_note: Cryptopolitan says Cryptio warned customers on 22 November; the company's own alert was not read.
geo_basis: The page names no location for Cryptio; placeholder point, not a real place
summary: Cryptopolitan reports that Cryptio, a crypto accounting platform, warned customers on 22 November that login credentials for partner exchanges and custodians could be compromised. A company representative said on 26 November that attempts to move assets with some credentials failed and no losses have been identified. Blockonomi reports Cryptio took the platform offline and hired an independent incident response firm; Cryptio says the intruder used AI tools.
plain: Cryptopolitan reports Cryptio warned that credentials linking customers' exchange and custodian accounts could be compromised. A company representative says attempts to move assets failed and no losses have been identified.
exec: Cryptopolitan reports credentials Cryptio held for customers' exchange and custodian accounts could be compromised; the company says attempts to move assets failed and no losses have been identified.
action: As reported by Blockonomi, Cryptio asks clients to revoke all API keys at their source, including read-only keys, check accounts for unapproved transfers or permission changes, and not reconnect old keys or add new ones until further notice.

validation.note: Cryptopolitan and Blockonomi were read; both relay Cryptio's own statements (single source in effect). Cryptopolitan relays Cryptio's 22 November alert and a company representative's 26 November statement. The LinkedIn alert and a crypto.news report were not read.

review.note: summary trimmed to 75 words; AI claim attributed to the company per Blockonomi; dates, action, validation checked against both sources
